{{MapTabs|Story|Waves = No|Rewards = No}} This page contains the official story elements included in Night III of the [[Hexscape Event]]. Most of the content is expressed through cutscenes, though some dialogue is important to the storyline. {{RightTOC}} ==Story Overview== This is the third night for the [[Hexscape Event]], meaning that the story takes place after the events in [[The Nightmare Realm]]. [[Commander]], [[Scout]] and [[Minigunner]] escape from the Hex Realm after defeating the [[Conserver]]. This, however, released corrupted energy into the [[Failed Gateway|Eclipsed Village]], completely destroying it. The [[Primordial Drakobloxxer|source of the energy]] was also detected to be coming towards the portal, alongside the hostiles from the realm. [[Scout]] tries to shut down the portal, but to no avail. [[Dispatcher]] then sends in [[Hallow Punk]] and [[Harvester]] to help out fend off the incoming forces. While the [[T.D.S. Organization]] defends the ruins of the [[Failed Gateway|Eclipsed Village]], [[Dispatcher]] finds out that the source of the energy is a [[God Cube]] fragment. The energy released from the fragment has also corrupted the inhabitants of the realm, though so far none of them are visibly corrupted. Later, while looking into the realm, the [[Dispatcher]] is unable to find it in the records, which would make [[Children of Exo]] the first to access it. This turns out to not be the case, as the realm has been accessed before but through a private realm network, which likely belongs to [[Lord Exo]]. She also informs the agents that it is not possible to close the portal, meaning they have to defeat every enemy coming out of it. Constant roars can be heard from an [[Primordial Drakobloxxer|entity]], which the [[Dispatcher]] seems to recognize. She finds out these were first heard around the time of the [[Lunar Overture Event|Overture Incident]]. The source is believed to be a powerful entity corrupted by the [[God Cube]], taken by [[Lord Exo]] sometime after [[The Umbra]] was defeated. How it ended up in the Hex Realm is not known. As the battle goes on, two fully corrupted entities come out of the portal. The first is [[Corrupted Titus|Titus]] and the second is [[Corrupted Conserver (Hexscape)|Conserver]]. They got corrupted by the release of energy that happened shortly after the [[Conserver]] was defeated. While fighting the [[Corrupted Conserver (Hexscape)|Conserver]], he reveals that his defeat released [[Primordial Drakobloxxer|something]] which he has been conserving in the Hex Realm. This entity would be the source of the corrupted energy. Both of the corrupted enemies are defeated, with [[Corrupted Titus|Titus]] specifically being confirmed dead. Eventually, the source of the corruption comes out of the portal. This turns out to be a [[God Cube]] fragment wielded by the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]]. The [[T.D.S. Organization]] gets into a fight with it and once defeated, attempt to take its fragment. The [[Hallow Punk]], which was seen at the start of the fight, is nowhere to be seen when the [[T.D.S. Organization]] attempts to retrieve the fragment. However, they are stopped by the [[Children of Exo]], who take the shard themselves, eventually escaping through a portal with it. [[Dispatcher]] then mentions gearing up so that they can deal with the cultists. After securing the fragment for themselves, they decide to use it to invade the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. Ramiel, one of the three remaining cultists, is then sent to start the [[Operation I.C.E Event|Operation I.C.E]]. ==Opening Cutscene== [[File:Hexscape Night 3 Cutscene 1|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays when the timer counts down to 0:00 before the game starts. The map has not yet changed, and the player's point of view is changed to a full screen third person view of the cutscene when the cutscene begins. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
[[Commander]], [[Scout]] and [[Minigunner]] leave the portal on a barren wasteland. The Dispatcher informs them that defeating the [[Conserver]] appears to have released a high amount of corrupted energy back in the hex dimension, and it is headed to their location along with all the hostiles from the hex dimension. The Dispatcher says supports were sent to help shutting down the portal, which are [[Hallow Punk]] and [[Harvester]], while wishing good luck to the team.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Script'''
''Three agents arrive the next dimension'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: So we got a new issue. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Exterminating The Conserver in the Hex Dimension set something off. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: It released a metric ton of corrupted energy into the original portal's location. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: And we believe it's headed directly this way along with all of those hostiles from that dimension. ''The computer still malfunctions, the [[Harvester|scarecrow]] and [[Hallow Punk|pumpkin rocketeer]] appear behind the three agents defending with the supercomputer.'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: We've sent in some support to help you guys get that portal shut down so we can end this whole mess once and for all. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Good Luck guys. You're absolutely gonna need it...
==Boss Cutscene== [[File:Hexscape Night 3 Cutscene 2|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays when [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] is about to appear at Wave 30. The player's point of view is changed to a third person view of the cutscene when the cutscene begins. When the cutscene ends, the Primordial Drakobloxxer spawns on the map's starting point. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
A large, red arthropod-like creature walks out of the portal, screaming and stomping, with Dispatcher being shocked.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Script'''
''A large, red arthropod-like creature comes out through the portal.'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Oh my God... ''The [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] screams and then stomps.''
==Ending Cutscene== [[File:Hexscape Night 3 Cutscene 3|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays a couple seconds after finishing Wave 30, as soon as the triumph dialogue box appears. When this cutscene ends, the match concludes. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the ending cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
With the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] defeated, [[Scout|the]] [[Commander|three]] [[Minigunner|agents]] rush to the [[God Cube]] fragment to pick it, but two men show up and one picks it first, while the other man mockingly thanks the team for doing all the work for them. Both the cultists rush into the portal and the agents go after them, only for the portal to deactivate, much to the Dispatcher's anger. The screen turns pitch black, one of the cultists informs another that T.D.S has caught on to them, asking for instructions. He is simply answered that with the [[God Cube]] fragment, T.D.S does not pose a threat and will be crushed with a swift invasion, revealing eyes and halo of the [[Frost Spirit]]. The cultist then tells Ramiel to initiate Operation I.C.E, ending the cutscene.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the ending cutscene.
'''Script'''
''The Drakobloxxer lays dead, with the [[God Cube]] fragment in the ground. Three agents rush to it but two cultists get the fragment first'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: WAIT WHERE DID THESE GUYS COME FROM? {{Color|CultistGreen|???}}: Thank you for doing all the grunt work for us mere mortals! ''The cultists run to the portal'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: (Grunts) STOP THEM!!!!! {{Color|CultistGreen|???}}: Until we meet again you ragtag crew of brawn for brains! ''After another cultist said his final message, he also enters the portal, then it is turned off'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: This... Couldn't have been their plan this entire time. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Well, let's gear up, and bring these cultists to justice... ''The screen turns pitch black'' {{Color|CultistPink|?????}}: It seems T.D.S. has caught on to us. How should we handle them? {{Color|CultistGreen|???}}: With a shard of the [[God Cube]] in our possession, they're no longer a threat. {{Color|CultistGreen|???}}: We'll crush them with a swift invasion. {{Color|CultistGreen|???}}: Ramiel, initiate Operation I.C.E. ''Two eyes and a halo are revealed'' {{Color|Ramiel}}: Yes sir!
